in_marathi.name: Baidhnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Auspiciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baidhnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baidhnath is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, referring to Lord Shiva as the Lord of Auspiciousness. He is a revered deity in Hinduism, believed to bring prosperity, good fortune, and protection. The name is a source of inspiration for those seeking blessings of abundance and success.
